verdict: A near-identical rebuild with every element, icon and line wrap in place; the main slips are the image action buttons pushed about 8 dp right and over-rounded corners, and the structure is a well-named auto-layout tree with instances but no shared styles.

top_defects.where: save and share buttons on the featured image
top_defects.what: both circles about 22 px (8 dp) too far right: share button ends ~18 px from the image edge instead of ~40 px (15 dp)

top_defects.where: featured image and article summary card corners
top_defects.what: corner radii visibly larger than the reference's 16 dp image box and 8 dp summary card (rounder top corners, red arcs in the heatmap)
outer outline drawn as a full pill instead of the reference's rounded rectangle (~10 dp radius)
navigation top edge, icons and the card's cut-off bottom sit about 3-4 px higher than in the reference
no colour or text styles/variables (styled: 0): #202122, #54595d, #3366cc etc. repeated as raw values; component masters not in the frame

top_defects.where: module description, article title and extract
top_defects.what: sub-pixel glyph drift accumulating along lines (heatmap red on the second half of lines), otherwise same Roboto/Noto Serif sizes and wraps
leftover parts: a 73 px indicator inside the 47 px "For you" tab and a badge ellipse in every nav item (Home, Search, More) presumably hidden

strengths: Every text, line wrap and ellipsis matches the reference exactly, in Roboto and Noto Serif at the right sizes and colours
Icons, wordmark and globe come from the app's own drawables as vectors/images, red badges on Saved and Activity included
Clear named hierarchy (Status bar, App bar, Tabs row, Community banner, Featured article card, Bottom navigation) with auto-layout and instances for tabs, nav items and buttons
